title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable instruction-driven robotic manipulation, but they inherit oversized language backbones from pretrained VLMs whose capacity far exceeds what is needed for short robotic instructions. This raises a basic question: how much of a VLA model is actually necessary for closed-loop control? In this work, we study architectural redundancy in VLA models by using transformer block removal as a controlled intervention. We introduce \textbf{Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR)}, an analysis protocol that removes selected blocks from a pretrained VLA model and then fine-tunes the resulting model to measure whether the removed capacity was necessary for downstream control. To make this intervention reliable, we propose \textbf{GateProbe}, a one-shot virtual-gate sensitivity metric that ranks blocks by their contribution to the downstream action loss. Across multiple VLA architectures, manipulation benchmarks and even real-robot industrial scenarios, we find a strong asymmetry in post-removal recoverability: \ul{\textit{language backbones are highly redundant for standard robotic manipulation tasks, whereas vision and action pathways are substantially less tolerant to removal}}. On LIBERO, removing half of the LLM blocks even improves OpenVLA-OFT from 95.0% to 98.3% under the same downstream fine-tuning budget, and retaining only two language blocks still recovers baseline-level performance. These results suggest that current VLA benchmarks may exert limited pressure on deep language grounding and compositional instruction understanding, and that future VLA architectures should allocate capacity more deliberately across language, vision, and action components. The code is available at https://github.com/s1ghhh/VLADrop.
tldr: This paper introduces Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR) and GateProbe to analyze redundancy in vision-language-action (VLA) models, finding that language backbone blocks are highly redundant for robotic manipulation while vision and action pathways are critical.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR) 和 GateProbe 方法来分析视觉-语言-操作（VLA）模型中的冗余性，发现语言主干块对机器人操作任务高度冗余，而视觉和动作路径至关重要。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型支持指令驱动的机器人操作，但其从预训练VLM中继承了过大的语言主干网络，其容量远超简短机器人指令所需。这引出一个基本问题：闭环控制实际需要VLA模型的多少容量？本研究通过将Transformer模块移除作为受控干预手段，探究VLA模型中的架构冗余。我们提出**Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR)**分析协议，从预训练VLA模型中移除选定模块，然后对压缩后的模型进行微调，以判断被移除的容量是否对下游控制必不可少。为使该干预手段可靠，我们提出**GateProbe**单次虚拟门控灵敏度指标，根据各模块对下游动作损失的贡献度进行排序。在多种VLA架构、操作基准乃至真实机器人工业场景中，我们发现了移除后恢复能力的显著不对称性：\ul{\textit{语言主干网络对标准机器人操作任务高度冗余，而视觉与动作通路对移除的容忍度则明显较低}}。在LIBERO基准上，移除半数LLM模块甚至能使OpenVLA-OFT在同等下游微调预算下从95.0%提升至98.3%，仅保留两个语言模块即可恢复基线性能。这些结果表明，当前VLA基准对深层语言基础与组合指令理解施加的压力有限，未来VLA架构应在语言、视觉与动作组件间更审慎地分配容量。代码开源于https://github.com/s1ghhh/VLADrop。

title: Direct Action-Head Injection of A Grounded 3D Point Unlocks Spatial and Task Generalization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for flexible robot manipulation, yet at test time they remain brittle along two axes: spatial generalization, when object positions differ from those seen during training, and task generalization, when a familiar scene is paired with a different language instruction than the one seen in training. A growing family of methods addresses this brittleness by endowing a policy with the spatial and task-aware information such as 2D pixel-coordinate for object localization and placement. However, we find that existing representation through language prompting or visual prompting does not address the limitations; in contrast, exploiting a 3D point-based representation and feeding it directly to the action head leads to substantial improvements-revealing that how the grounding signal is represented and injected into the VLA is the true game changer. Thus, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic module that represents the grounding signal in 3D, computes its relative displacement to the gripper, and injects the resulting spatial embedding directly into the action head through adaptive layer normalization. The entire module is a two-layer MLP that requires no changes to the VLA backbone or pretraining pipeline. On LIBERO-PRO, our method improves the average success rate of GR00T-N1.6 from 31.2 to 77.5 points under task perturbation and from 28.1 to 60.2 points under position perturbation (gains of 46.3 and 32.1 points). Comparable gains are achieved for $π_{0.5}$ as well, demonstrating that the mechanism is backbone-agnostic. Together, these results support our central finding: given adequate grounding lifted into 3D, injecting it directly into the action head is what unlocks both spatial and task generalization in VLAs-achievable with nothing more than a lightweight module on top of a pretrained backbone.
tldr: Proposes a lightweight, backbone-agnostic module that injects 3D grounding signals directly into the action head of VLA models via adaptive layer normalization, dramatically improving spatial and task generalization on LIBERO-PRO.
tldr_zh: 提出一个轻量级、与骨干网络无关的模块，通过自适应层归一化直接将3D接地信号注入VLA模型的动作头，在LIBERO-PRO上大幅提升空间和任务泛化能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用大规模视觉-语言预训练实现灵活的机器人操作，但在测试时仍存在两个维度的脆弱性：空间泛化（当物体位置与训练时不同）和任务泛化（当熟悉场景搭配的训练语言指令发生改变）。当前一系列方法通过赋予策略空间与任务感知信息（如用于物体定位与放置的2D像素坐标）来缓解这一脆弱性。然而，我们发现现有基于语言提示或视觉提示的表征方式并未解决这些局限；相反，利用3D点云表征并将其直接输入动作头能带来显著改进——这揭示了将接地信号如何表征并注入VLA模型才是真正的关键变革因素。为此，我们提出一个轻量级、模型无关的模块，该模块在3D空间中表征接地信号，计算其与夹爪的相对位移，并通过自适应层归一化将生成的空间嵌入直接注入动作头。整个模块仅由两层MLP组成，无需修改VLA主干网络或预训练流程。在LIBERO-PRO基准上，我们的方法在任务扰动下将GR00T-N1.6的平均成功率从31.2%提升至77.5%（提升46.3个百分点），在位置扰动下从28.1%提升至60.2%（提升32.1个百分点）。π₀.₅模型也获得了相当的提升，表明该机制具有主干无关性。这些结果共同支撑我们的核心发现：在将接地信号提升至3D表征后，直接注入动作头是解锁VLA空间与任务泛化能力的关键——仅需在预训练主干上添加一个轻量级模块即可实现。

title: Support-Constrained RL Enables Real-World Policy Improvement without Real-World Experience
summary: Robots trained on real world data tend to be imprecise, slow, and brittle to perturbations. Improving these policies with reinforcement learning (RL) is an appealing alternative, but this process often requires expensive training in the real world. Performing policy improvement in simulation instead provides a far cheaper alternative, but unconstrained RL in simulation can exploit contact and dynamics mismatches, resulting in unsafe behaviors that do not transfer to hardware. Common forms of regularization can furthermore limit improvement by overconstraining to an imperfect behavior prior. In this work, we propose Support-Constrained Off-Domain REinforcement (SCORE), a real-to-sim-to-real framework that constrains RL in simulation to the support of a generative policy pretrained on real data. We instantiate this constraint through flow steering, restricting SCORE to actions the base policy can already produce, which ensures transferable behaviors while maximizing policy improvement. Improving a policy with SCORE requires minimal effort: it learns from sparse rewards, avoids distillation, and leaves the base policy untouched. Across eight real-world dexterous multi-fingered robotic manipulation tasks, SCORE improves average success rate from 37.8% to 89.9%, compared to 59.5% for the best baseline, and reaches success in 36.8% fewer steps than the base policy. Ultimately, through extensive experiments and ablations, we show that simulation can substantially improve real-world manipulation policies when policy optimization is appropriately constrained, introducing a new paradigm for real-to-sim-to-real policy improvement. Videos and code are available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/.
tldr: SCORE proposes a support-constrained RL framework that improves real-world robotic manipulation policies by constraining simulation-based RL to the action support of a generative policy pretrained on real data, achieving significant success rate improvements across dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: SCORE提出了一种支持约束的强化学习框架，通过将基于仿真的RL约束在真实数据预训练生成性策略的行为支持集内，显著提升了真实世界机器人灵巧操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 基于真实世界数据训练的机器人往往存在精度不足、响应迟缓且易受扰动影响的问题。利用强化学习（RL）改进这些策略虽具吸引力，但该过程通常需要在真实环境中进行昂贵的训练。相比之下，在仿真环境中进行策略改进提供了更为经济的替代方案，但未经约束的仿真RL会利用接触与动力学失配问题，导致无法迁移至硬件的危险行为。常见的正则化方法通过过度约束到不完美的行为先验，反而可能限制策略改进。为此，本文提出支持约束域外强化学习（SCORE）框架，该真实-仿真-真实框架将仿真中的RL限制在基于真实数据预训练的生成式策略的支持集内。我们通过流导向技术实例化该约束，将SCORE限制在基础策略已能产生的动作空间内，从而在最大化策略改进的同时确保行为的可迁移性。使用SCORE改进策略只需极少投入：它从稀疏奖励中学习，无需知识蒸馏，且保持基础策略不变。在八项真实世界灵巧多指机器人操作任务中，SCORE将平均成功率从37.8%提升至89.9%（最佳基线为59.5%），且相较于基础策略，成功所需的步骤数减少36.8%。最终，通过大量实验与消融研究，我们证明了当策略优化受到适当约束时，仿真能显著改进真实世界的操作策略，开创了真实-仿真-真实策略改进的新范式。视频与代码详见https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/。

title: ReWorld: Learning Better Representations for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) model future environment evolution under action conditioning, offering a scalable paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing approaches focus largely on model architecture design, and how a WAM can efficiently learn better world representations for planning remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose ReWorld, the first representation learning framework specifically designed for autonomous-driving world action models. In WAMs, standard training supervises only the output ends of the generation and planning modules, leaving the intermediate representations that carry world knowledge to be shaped only indirectly, as byproducts of fitting these outputs. The core idea of ReWorld is to treat intermediate representations as direct targets of optimization, shaping them along three complementary dimensions. On the Video DiT responsible for generation, we impose future-predictive supervision on its intermediate representations. On the Action DiT responsible for planning, we first align its intermediate representations cross-modally with the video world representation, then further shape them to be discriminative around safety-critical boundaries via hard-negative supervision. In addition, we systematically analyze the effectiveness of existing representation learning methods in video generation world models, and discuss why their performance is limited on this task. Experiments on nuScenes and NAVSIM show that ReWorld improves fine-tuned video generation by 23.9% in FVD (81.3 to 61.9), raises closed-loop PDMS from 89.1 to 90.4 without any post-training such as RL or post-processing, and accelerates from-scratch convergence by approximately 2x.
tldr: ReWorld introduces a representation learning framework for world action models in autonomous driving, directly optimizing intermediate representations through future-predictive, cross-modal, and hard-negative supervision, achieving significant gains in video generation and closed-loop planning.
tldr_zh: ReWorld 提出了一个专为自动驾驶世界动作模型设计的表征学习框架，通过未来预测监督、跨模态对齐和难负样本监督直接优化中间表征，显著提升了视频生成和闭环规划性能。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）在动作条件约束下建模未来环境演化，为自动驾驶提供了一种可扩展的范式。然而，现有方法主要关注模型架构设计，而WAM如何高效学习更优的规划世界表征仍未被充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出ReWorld——首个专为自动驾驶世界行动模型设计的表征学习框架。在WAMs中，标准训练仅监督生成模块与规划模块的输出端，导致承载世界知识的中间表征仅作为拟合输出的副产品被间接塑造。ReWorld的核心思想是将中间表征作为直接优化目标，沿三个互补维度进行塑造。对于负责生成的Video DiT，我们对其中间表征施加未来预测性监督；对于负责规划的Action DiT，我们首先将其中间表征与视频世界表征进行跨模态对齐，随后通过困难负样本监督进一步塑造其在安全关键边界附近的判别性。此外，我们系统分析了现有表征学习方法在视频生成世界模型中的有效性，并探讨其在此任务中性能受限的原因。在nuScenes与NAVSIM上的实验表明，ReWorld将微调后视频生成的FVD指标从81.3降至61.9（提升23.9%），闭环PDMS评分从89.1提升至90.4且无需强化学习等后训练或后处理，同时将从头训练的收敛速度提升约2倍。

title: DexCompose: Reusing Dexterous Policies for Multi-Task Manipulation with a Single Hand
summary: Dexterous manipulation policies can solve individual skills, but composing them to perform multiple tasks with a single hand remains challenging. Adding a new task on top of an existing manipulation skill often imposes conflicting demands on overlapping fingers and contact modes, causing destructive interference between preserving an existing manipulation outcome and executing a new one. We propose DexCompose, a role-aware residual composition framework that reuses pretrained dexterous policies for multi-task manipulation through explicit finger-level action ownership. Given two pretrained full-hand policies, DexCompose first collects successful post-task states from the first skill and performs release tests over candidate finger masks to identify which fingers are necessary for maintaining the established skill state. It then trains two asymmetric residual modules: a bounded residual stabilizer for task preservation, and a context-aware residual that adapts the frozen downstream policy only within the action subspace assigned to the new task. We evaluate the framework on 16 composite dexterous manipulation tasks spanning four object-retention skills and four downstream interactions. DexCompose achieves a 77.4% average composite success rate, demonstrating that structural action ownership with dual residuals offers a promising direction for composing dexterous skills beyond conventional policy chaining.
tldr: DexCompose composes pretrained dexterous manipulation policies for multi-task single-hand operation by assigning explicit finger-level action ownership and using asymmetric residual modules to prevent task interference.
tldr_zh: DexCompose 通过显式的指级动作所有权分配和不对称残差模块，组合预训练的灵巧操作策略，实现单手多任务操作，避免任务间干扰。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作策略能够解决单一技能问题，但如何组合这些策略以用单手执行多任务仍具挑战性。在现有操作技能基础上添加新任务时，往往会对重叠的手指和接触模式产生冲突需求，导致维持现有操作结果与执行新操作之间产生破坏性干扰。我们提出DexCompose——一种角色感知的残差组合框架，通过显式的手指级动作所有权复用预训练的灵巧策略实现多任务操作。给定两个预训练的全手策略，DexCompose首先从第一个技能中收集成功的后任务状态，并在候选手指掩码上执行释放测试，以识别维持已建立技能状态所必需的手指。随后训练两个非对称残差模块：一个用于任务维持的有界残差稳定器，以及一个仅在新任务分配的动作子空间内适配冻结下游策略的上下文感知残差。我们在涵盖四项物体保持技能和四项下游交互的16个复合灵巧操作任务上评估该框架，DexCompose实现了77.4%的平均复合成功率，表明具有双残差的结构化动作所有权为超越传统策略链路的灵巧技能组合提供了有前景的方向。

title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation
summary: Scaling imitation learning requires large datasets, yet human teleoperation inevitably produces mixed-quality demonstrations containing hesitations and recoveries. Prior frame-level progress reward models supervise on absolute temporal progress proxies that suffer from label noise, or require costly human annotations to define subtask boundaries. We present WARP (Warp-Augmented Relative Progress), a novel fully self-supervised algorithm for learning dense, signed relative progress magnitudes directly from successful demonstrations. WARP generates per-frame progress targets via time-warp augmentations of demonstrations (variable playback speeds and reversals) and we train WARP-RM to predict the normalized elapsed time between input frames. Aggregating these predictions across overlapping windows yields a dense frame-level progress signal. We then introduce WARP-BC, which leverages these scalar reward estimates to upweight high-advantage action chunks during behavior cloning, where chunk-level advantage is obtained by aggregating per-frame rewards. We evaluate our approach on a physical bimanual robot system performing a long-horizon deformable object manipulation task: folding T-shirts from a random crumpled start. To evaluate policy robustness against suboptimal data, we construct training datasets of varying quality using episode length as a proxy for teleoperation sub-optimality. As the dataset is widened to admit more inefficiencies, WARP-BC maintains a 19/20 success rate compared to vanilla BC's collapse to 2/20, improving throughput by up to 18x.
tldr: WARP-RM proposes a self-supervised method to learn dense progress rewards from robot demonstrations by using time-warp augmentations, and uses these rewards to improve behavior cloning performance on a bimanual T-shirt folding task, maintaining high success rates even with suboptimal data.
tldr_zh: WARP-RM 提出了一种自监督方法，通过时间扭曲增强从机器人演示中学习密集的进度奖励，并利用这些奖励改进行为克隆在双臂叠衬衫任务上的表现，即使在次优数据下也能保持高成功率。
summary_zh: 缩放模仿学习需要大规模数据集，但人类遥操作不可避免地会产生包含犹豫和恢复动作的混合质量示范。先前的帧级进度奖励模型基于绝对时间进度代理进行监督，这类代理存在标签噪声问题，或需要昂贵的人工标注来定义子任务边界。我们提出WARP（Warp-Augmented Relative Progress，扭曲增强相对进度）算法，这是一种全新的完全自监督方法，可直接从成功示范中学习密集的有符号相对进度幅值。WARP通过对示范施加时间扭曲增强（可变播放速度与逆序播放）生成每帧进度目标，并训练WARP-RM预测输入帧之间的归一化经过时间。通过跨重叠窗口聚合这些预测，可得到密集的帧级进度信号。我们随后引入WARP-BC，该方法在行为克隆中利用这些标量奖励估计值提升高优势动作块的权重，其中块级优势通过聚合每帧奖励获得。我们在一个执行长时域可变形物体操作任务的物理双臂机器人系统上评估该方法：从随机揉皱的起始状态折叠T恤。为评估策略对次优数据的鲁棒性，我们使用回合长度作为遥操作次优性的代理指标，构建了不同质量的训练数据集。当数据集扩展以容纳更多低效示范时，WARP-BC保持19/20的成功率，而原始行为克隆退化至2/20，吞吐量提升高达18倍。

title: CacheMPC: Certified Cached Model Predictive Control for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) is the standard predictive layer in hierarchical quadruped controllers, but the per-cycle QP solve limits the update rate achievable on embedded processors. Because legged gaits revisit a bounded region of state space, MPC solutions admit caching and reuse. This paper proposes \emph{Certified CacheMPC}: a Locality-Sensitive-Hashed cache of horizon contact-force trajectories, partitioned by contact mode, retrieved at query time and accepted only when an a-posteriori per-query certificate confirms primal feasibility and a Lagrangian dual-gap upper bound on cost suboptimality. A bounded-budget controller schedule combines top-$K$ certified retrieval, a deadline-bounded QP solve, and a shifted last-certified fallback. The framework is evaluated on a Unitree Go2 across $2{,}038$ usable cold-controller MuJoCo trials, including a $600$-trial $n\!=\!50$ campaign at three failure-boundary cells, and a first-deploy session on the on-robot NVIDIA Orin NX. The un-gated cache delivers a $25\times$ median solve-time speedup in simulation and an $18.7\times$ median speedup on hardware. At $n\!=\!50$ no statistically significant difference in closed-loop stable rate is detected between the cache variants and the no-cache baseline at any tested cell. The certificate's contribution to closed-loop safety is not resolvable at the present sample size.
tldr: CacheMPC uses a locality-sensitive hash cache to reuse past MPC solutions for quadruped locomotion, achieving 25× speedup in simulation and 18.7× on hardware without statistically significant loss in stability.
tldr_zh: CacheMPC 通过局部敏感哈希缓存复用以往 MPC 解，在四足 locomotion 中实现仿真 25 倍、硬件 18.7 倍加速，且稳定性无显著下降。
summary_zh: 模型预测控制（MPC）是分层四足控制器中的标准预测层，但每周期二次规划求解限制了嵌入式处理器可实现的更新频率。由于足式运动状态空间的可遍历区域具有边界性，MPC解支持缓存与重用。本文提出**认证缓存MPC**：一种基于局部敏感哈希的时域接触力轨迹缓存，按接触模式分区，查询时检索，仅当后验逐查询证书确认原始可行性且拉格朗日对偶间隙提供成本次优性上界时才被接受。有限预算控制器调度组合了前K个认证检索、截止时间约束的二次规划求解以及移位末次认证回退策略。该框架在宇树Go2上进行了评估：涵盖2038次可用冷启动控制器MuJoCo实验（包括600次n=50的三种故障边界单元试验）以及首次在机器人端NVIDIA Orin NX上的部署测试。无门控缓存在仿真中实现25倍中位求解加速，在硬件上实现18.7倍中位加速。在n=50条件下，所有测试单元中缓存变体与无缓存基线在闭环稳定率上均未检测到统计显著性差异。当前样本量下，证书对闭环安全性的贡献尚无法解析。

title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
summary: Training and evaluating robot policies in the real world is costly and difficult to scale. We introduce SimFoundry, a modular and automated system for zero-shot real-to-sim scene construction from a video. SimFoundry generates sim-ready digital twins and supports object, scene, and task editing, enabling the automated generation of diverse digital cousins: affordance-preserving variations of reconstructed real-world scenes. Policies trained on SimFoundry data transfer zero-shot to challenging real tasks involving multi-step manipulation, articulated object interaction, and bimanual interaction, and its digital cousins (variations of the original scene, objects, and tasks) facilitate generalization to new real-world conditions. Across 7 manipulation tasks and 5 policy architectures, SimFoundry simulation evaluations strongly predict real-world performance, with mean Pearson correlation 0.911 and mean maximum ranking violation 0.018. When evaluating sim-trained policies zero-shot in the real world, policies trained with object, scene, and task cousins in simulation show average task success rate improvements of 17%, 21%, and 40%, respectively. Additional details at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/simfoundry/ .
tldr: SimFoundry is a modular system that automatically creates simulation-ready digital twins from real-world video, enabling zero-shot transfer of robot policies trained in simulation to real-world tasks with high correlation between simulation and real performance.
tldr_zh: SimFoundry是一个模块化系统，能从真实世界视频自动创建可仿真数字孪生，使在仿真中训练的机器人策略能够零样本迁移到真实任务，仿真与真实性能高度相关。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在真实世界中训练和评估机器人策略成本高昂且难以规模化。我们提出SimFoundry——一个模块化、自动化的系统，能够从视频中零样本构建真实到仿真的场景。SimFoundry可生成可直接用于仿真的数字孪生体，并支持对象、场景及任务的编辑，从而实现多样化数字孪生变体的自动生成——即保留原真实场景功能属性的变化版本。基于SimFoundry数据训练的策略可直接零样本迁移至涉及多步骤操作、铰接物体交互及双臂交互等挑战性的真实任务中；其生成的数字孪生变体（原始场景、对象及任务的变体）有助于提升对新型真实环境的泛化能力。在7个操作任务与5种策略架构的测试中，SimFoundry的仿真评估结果能强有力地预测真实世界性能，平均皮尔逊相关系数为0.911，最大排序违规率平均值为0.018。在零样本真实世界评估中，使用仿真中生成的对象变体、场景变体及任务变体训练的策略，其平均任务成功率分别提升了17%、21%和40%。更多详情请访问 https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/simfoundry/ 。

title: PA-BiCoop: A Primary-Auxiliary Cooperative Framework for General Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Bimanual manipulation is essential for advanced robotic systems because it offers higher efficiency and flexibility compared to single-arm configurations. However, existing approaches either lack inter-arm interaction or ignore the need for a dynamic division of labor, treating the arms as functionally equivalent. To address these limitations, this paper draws inspiration from human bimanual manipulation where one arm handles core operations and the other provides auxiliary support, and proposes PA-BiCoop, a new single-model bimanual cooperation framework with dynamic primary-auxiliary arm differentiation. PA-BiCoop categorizes robotic arms into primary and auxiliary arms with adaptively adjustable roles across task stages, employs two specialized decoders that share a global feature encoder: the primary decoder generates the primary arm's base-coordinate pose and core-task affordance heatmaps, and the auxiliary decoder outputs the auxiliary arm's relative pose in the primary arm's coordinate system. Moreover, we design a dynamic role assignment module to automatically map roles to left/right arms without manual pre-definition. This design facilitates inter-arm knowledge sharing and coordinated manipulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our PA-BiCoop achieves superior performance: it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 48% on average in RLBench2 simulation tasks and by over 50% on average in real world tasks, thereby verifying its effectiveness and advancement in bimanual manipulation.
tldr: PA-BiCoop proposes a primary-auxiliary cooperative framework for general bimanual manipulation, with dynamic role assignment and specialized decoders, achieving significant performance improvements over baselines in both simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: PA-BiCoop 提出了一种主从协作的双臂操作框架，支持动态角色分配和专用解码器，在仿真和真实任务中均显著优于现有基线方法。
summary_zh: 双臂操控对于先进机器人系统至关重要，因为与单臂配置相比，它能提供更高的效率和灵活性。然而，现有方法要么缺乏臂间交互，要么忽略了对动态分工的需求，将双臂视为功能等效。为解决这些局限性，本文从人类双臂操控中汲取灵感——其中一只手臂处理核心操作，另一只提供辅助支持——并提出PA-BiCoop，一种具有动态主辅臂区分的新型单模型双臂协作框架。PA-BiCoop将机械臂分为主臂和辅臂，其角色可在任务阶段中自适应调整，并采用两个共享全局特征编码器的专用解码器：主解码器生成主臂的基坐标位姿及核心任务可供性热图，辅解码器输出辅臂在主臂坐标系中的相对位姿。此外，我们设计了一个动态角色分配模块，可自动将角色映射至左/右臂，无需人工预定义。这一设计促进了臂间知识共享与协调操控。大量实验表明，我们的PA-BiCoop实现了卓越性能：在RLBench2模拟任务中平均超越现有最优基线方法48%，在真实世界任务中平均超越50%以上，从而验证了其在双臂操控中的有效性与先进性。

title: Translation as a Bridging Action: Transferring Manipulation Skills from Humans to Robots
summary: We study whether we can learn novel manipulation skills from human actions to a bi-manual robot with parallel grippers. Human action data is cheap, abundant, and diverse, making it one of the most promising resources for scaling up robot learning. Yet transferring skills from humans to robots remains hard: most prior work treats humans as just another bi-manual 6DoF embodiment, where hand-pose estimates are noisy and the contact patterns of human fingers differ fundamentally from those of a parallel gripper. We argue that learning rotation-inclusive action signals from human data is therefore sub-optimal, and instead propose a bridging action representation: the relative wrist translation within the initial head-camera frame, an action space shared by humans and robots. To handle the potential absence of certain action components in different embodiments, we build a $π_0$-like vision-language-action model with interleaved action tokens and attention masking. On a suite of novel bi-manual manipulation tasks, our bridging action transfers human manipulation knowledge to robots far more effectively than noisy 6DoF human actions and scales with the amount of human data.
tldr: The paper proposes a 'bridging action' representation—relative wrist translation in the initial head-camera frame—to transfer bimanual manipulation skills from human demonstration data to a robot with parallel grippers, and builds a π₀-like VLA model with interleaved action tokens and attention masking to handle embodiment differences.
tldr_zh: 论文提出一种“桥接动作”表示——初始头部相机坐标系下的相对手腕平移——将人类双手操作的技能迁移到具有平行夹爪的机器人上，并构建类似π₀的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过交错动作标记和注意力掩码处理不同本体的差异。
summary_zh: 我们研究能否从人类动作中学习新型操作技能，并将其迁移至配备平行夹爪的双臂机器人。人类动作数据具有廉价、丰富且多样化的特点，是扩展机器人学习规模最有前景的资源之一。然而，将技能从人类迁移至机器人仍然困难重重：现有工作大多将人类视为另一种双臂六自由度具身形态，其手部姿态估计存在噪声，且人类手指的接触模式与平行夹爪存在根本差异。我们认为，从人类数据中学习包含旋转信息的动作信号并非最优方案，因此提出一种桥接动作表征：以初始头部相机坐标系为基准的相对腕部平移——这是人类与机器人共享的动作空间。为应对不同具身形态中可能缺失部分动作分量的问题，我们构建了一个类似π₀的视觉-语言-动作模型，采用交错排列的动作令牌与注意力掩码机制。在一组新型双臂操作任务中，我们的桥接动作将人类操作知识迁移至机器人的效率远高于含噪的六自由度人类动作，且性能随人类数据量提升而扩展。

title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Video generation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied world simulation. However, both general-domain video generators and robot-specific data fine-tuned models can still produce physically implausible manipulations, including discontinuous motion trajectories and inconsistent robot-object interactions, which limits their reliability as world simulators. Through extensive experiments, we find that such physical instability mainly arises from two factors: deformation of moving objects and implausible spatio-temporal correlations among interacting entities, particularly during contact. Building on this observation, we propose PhysisForcing, a scalable training framework that strengthens physical consistency by focusing supervision on physics-informative regions through joint optimization of pixel-level and semantic-level features. The framework consists of a pixel-level trajectory alignment loss, which supervises DiT features using reference point trajectories, and a semantic-level relational alignment loss, which aligns DiT features with inter-region relations extracted from a frozen video understanding encoder. Extensive experiments on R-Bench, PAI-Bench, and EZS-Bench show that PhysisForcing consistently improves embodied video generation over strong baselines, improving the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B and Cosmos3-Nano base models on R-Bench by 22.3\% and 9.2\% (7.1\% and 3.7\% over vanilla finetuning), with the Cosmos3-Nano variant attaining the best overall score. Beyond generation, as a world model under the WorldArena action-planner protocol it raises the closed-loop success rate from 16.0\% to 24.0\% and further improves downstream policy success, indicating that physically aligned video models yield stronger representations for robotic manipulation.
tldr: This paper introduces PhysisForcing, a training framework that enhances the physical consistency of video-based world models for robotic manipulation by jointly optimizing pixel-level and semantic-level features in physics-informative regions, leading to significant improvements in embodied video generation and downstream policy success in closed-loop control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PhysisForcing框架，通过对物理信息区域联合优化像素级和语义级特征，增强用于机器人操作的视频世界模型的物理一致性，显著提升了具身视频生成质量和闭环控制中的下游策略成功率。
summary_zh: 视频生成模型已成为具身世界模拟的一种有前景的范式。然而，无论是通用域视频生成器还是机器人特定数据微调模型，仍可能产生物理上不合理的操作，包括不连续的运动轨迹以及不一致的机器人-物体交互，这限制了其作为世界模拟器的可靠性。通过大量实验，我们发现此类物理不稳定性主要源于两个因素：运动物体的形变以及交互实体之间（尤其是接触过程中）不合理的时空关联。基于这一观察，我们提出了PhysisForcing，一种可扩展的训练框架，通过联合优化像素级与语义级特征，将监督聚焦于物理信息丰富的区域，从而增强物理一致性。该框架包含一个像素级轨迹对齐损失函数，利用参考点轨迹监督DiT特征；以及一个语义级关系对齐损失函数，将从冻结的视频理解编码器中提取的区域间关系与DiT特征对齐。在R-Bench、PAI-Bench和EZS-Bench上的大量实验表明，PhysisForcing在强基线模型上持续提升了具身视频生成性能，使Wan2.2-I2V-A14B和Cosmos3-Nano基模型在R-Bench上的得分分别提升22.3%和9.2%（较普通微调提升7.1%和3.7%），其中Cosmos3-Nano变体取得了最佳总体得分。除生成任务外，作为WorldArena动作规划器协议下的世界模型，该方法将闭环成功率从16.0%提升至24.0%，并进一步改善了下游策略的成功率，这表明物理对齐的视频模型能够为机器人操作提供更强的表征能力。

title: S$^2$-VLA: State-Space Guided Vision-Language-Action Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but their performance degrades significantly in long-horizon tasks due to cumulative error propagation. This limitation largely arises from static feature fusion mechanisms that rely on fixed weights to combine visual, language, and action representations, preventing the model from adapting to different phases of task execution. To address this limitation, we propose S$^2$-VLA, a framework that introduces a State-Space Guided Adaptive Attention (SSGAA) mechanism. SSGAA maintains a belief state that tracks task progression and generates dynamic gating weights to adaptively fuse information from three complementary sources visual features for spatial perception, task intents for high-level task planning, and temporal action sequences for execution consistency. This adaptive fusion allows the model to shift its focus throughout task execution, aligning with the evolving requirements of different task stages. Despite its compact 2B parameter size, S$^2$-VLA consistently outperforms larger 7B-scale models and achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and SimplerEnv. highlighting the importance of adaptive feature fusion for long-horizon robotic manipulation.
tldr: S2-VLA introduces a State-Space Guided Adaptive Attention (SSGAA) mechanism for adaptive feature fusion in VLA models, significantly improving long-horizon robotic manipulation and outperforming larger 7B-scale models.
tldr_zh: S2-VLA 提出了一种状态空间引导的自适应注意力机制，用于VLA模型中的自适应特征融合，显著提升了长期机器人操作任务的表现，超越了更大的7B参数模型。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出强大的能力，但在长时域任务中，由于累积误差传播，其性能显著下降。这一局限性主要源于静态特征融合机制——该机制依赖固定权重来组合视觉、语言和动作表征，导致模型无法适应任务执行的不同阶段。为解决这一问题，我们提出S$^2$-VLA框架，该框架引入了一种状态空间引导的自适应注意力（SSGAA）机制。SSGAA维护一个追踪任务进度的置信状态，并生成动态门控权重，以自适应地融合来自三个互补来源的信息：用于空间感知的视觉特征、用于高层任务规划的任务意图，以及用于执行一致性的时序动作序列。这种自适应融合使模型能够在任务执行过程中动态调整关注重点，从而契合不同任务阶段不断变化的需求。尽管其参数量仅为2B，但S$^2$-VLA持续优于更大的7B级模型，并在LIBERO和SimplerEnv等长时域操作基准测试中取得了最先进性能，这凸显了自适应特征融合对长时域机器人操作的关键意义。

title: LocalNav: Distilling Frontier VLMs and Embodied RL for On-Device Object Goal Navigation
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have emerged in the robotic domain as a powerful tool that enables environmental perception with language context, serving as a catalyst for open-vocabulary tasks like ObjectNav. Yet, their computational footprint typically confines them to cloud execution, hindering low-latency inference with local deployment on resource-constrained robots. To address this challenge, we present a distillation strategy that transfers complex spatial-semantic reasoning from large frontier models into a lightweight, 4B-parameter local VLM for edge execution on embedded GPU devices (e.g., Jetson Orin). We first establish a State of the Art (SotA), Scene Graph (SG)-based pipeline using Claude Sonnet 4.6, achieving a 39.7% Success Rate (SR) on the HM3D OVON benchmark. We then demonstrate that fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 500 frontier reasoning traces effectively enables navigation capabilities, yielding a SR of 34.5%, narrowing the gap to the performance of large cloud models. Finally, we introduce E-RLVR with Token Generation (TG) regularization to compress output sequence lengths for physical deployment while grounding the agent in its task. This downstream optimization reduces TG overhead by 72.1% and latency by 71.8%. Combined with quantization, this joint strategy yields a cumulative 82.8% reduction in overall inference latency without significantly sacrificing performance, presenting a viable paradigm for local, low-latency VLM execution on mobile robots.
tldr: This paper distills spatial-semantic reasoning from large frontier VLMs into a lightweight 4B-parameter local VLM for edge deployment in object goal navigation, achieving competitive success rates with dramatically reduced latency via E-RLVR with token generation regularization and quantization.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将大型前沿VLM的空间-语义推理能力蒸馏到轻量级4B参数本地VLM中，实现了在边缘设备上的目标导航，结合E-RLVR和Token生成正则化及量化，取得了有竞争力的成功率并大幅降低延迟。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已进入机器人领域，成为实现语言情境下环境感知的有力工具，并推动开放词汇任务（如ObjectNav）的发展。然而，其计算开销通常使其局限于云端执行，阻碍了在资源受限机器人上本地部署的低延迟推理。为解决这一难题，我们提出一种蒸馏策略，将复杂空间语义推理能力从大型前沿模型迁移至轻量级40亿参数的本地VLM，用于嵌入式GPU设备（如Jetson Orin）的端侧执行。首先，我们构建了基于场景图（SG）的当前最优（SotA）流程（采用Claude Sonnet 4.6），在HM3D OVON基准上实现39.7%的成功率（SR）。继而证明，仅需500条前沿推理轨迹微调Qwen3.5-4B即可有效习得导航能力，获得34.5%的SR，显著缩小了与大型云端模型的性能差距。最后，我们提出引入令牌生成（TG）正则化的E-RLVR方法，在压缩物理部署输出序列长度的同时，确保智能体任务锚定。该下游优化使TG开销降低72.1%，延迟降低71.8%。结合量化技术，该联合策略在不显著牺牲性能的前提下，累计降低整体推理延迟82.8%，为移动机器人本地低延迟VLM执行提供了可行范式。

title: PPO-EAL: Exact Augmented Lagrangian Proximal Policy Optimization for Safe Robotic Control
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising solution to accomplish complex robotic control tasks; however, most of the current work ignores the safety requirements. Safe RL seeks to maximize task performance while satisfying explicit physical constraints, but current algorithms struggle to learn the policy efficiently with precise constraint satisfaction. This work proposes PPO-EAL, a novel first-order constrained policy optimization framework that integrates exact augmented Lagrangian optimization into proximal policy optimization for safe robotic control. By combining clipped policy updates with exact quadratic penalty terms, PPO-EAL achieves theoretically grounded constraint enforcement without requiring impractically large penalty factors. A momentum-regulated multiplier update further improves dual-variable stability, reducing constraint oscillation and unsafe behavior while preserving task performance. We provide exactness and convergence analysis under standard stochastic approximation assumptions. Extensive validation across diverse GPU-accelerated robotic benchmarks-including cart-pole balancing, cart-double-pendulum stabilization, 7-DoF Franka end-effector reaching, and quadrupedal locomotion-demonstrates superior safety precision and reward performance compared with state-of-the-art first-order safe RL baselines. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real deployment in a contact-rich gear assembly task, where PPO-EAL substantially improves task success, reduces peak contact force, and enhances operational robustness. These results establish PPO-EAL as a general and practically deployable safe RL framework for diverse safety-critical robotic systems.
tldr: PPO-EAL integrates exact augmented Lagrangian optimization into PPO for safe robotic control, achieving theoretically grounded constraint enforcement with stable dual-variable updates and demonstrating strong results on diverse robotic benchmarks and zero-shot sim-to-real deployment.
tldr_zh: PPO-EAL将精确增广拉格朗日优化融入PPO，用于安全机器人控制，实现了理论上严谨的约束执行和稳定的对偶变量更新，在多种机器人基准和零样本仿真到现实部署中表现优异。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为完成复杂机器人控制任务的一种有前景的解决方案，然而现有工作大多忽略了安全需求。安全强化学习旨在满足显式物理约束的同时最大化任务性能，但现有算法难以在精确满足约束条件下高效地学习策略。本工作提出PPO-EAL，一种新颖的一阶约束策略优化框架，它将精确增广拉格朗日优化集成到近端策略优化中，用于安全机器人控制。通过将裁剪策略更新与精确二次惩罚项相结合，PPO-EAL实现了有理论依据的约束满足，且无需使用不切实际的大惩罚因子。动量调节乘子更新进一步改善了双变量稳定性，在保持任务性能的同时减少了约束振荡和不安全行为。我们在标准随机近似假设下提供了精确性与收敛性分析。在多种GPU加速机器人基准任务（包括推车-杆平衡、推车-双摆稳定、7自由度Franka末端执行器触碰以及四足运动）上的广泛验证表明，与最先进的一阶安全强化学习基线方法相比，本方法具有更优越的安全精度与奖励性能。最后，我们在接触丰富的齿轮装配任务中实现了零样本仿真到实物的部署，PPO-EAL显著提高了任务成功率，降低了峰值接触力，并增强了操作鲁棒性。这些成果将PPO-EAL确立为一种通用且可实际部署的安全强化学习框架，适用于各类安全关键型机器人系统。

title: Booster Lab: A Data-Centric Pipeline for Learning Deployable Humanoid Locomotion Policies
summary: Humanoid robot motion learning requires not only task-oriented control policies but also physically feasible and natural behaviors that can be transferred to real robots. However, robot-feasible motion data are often scarce: raw human demonstrations may be incompatible with the robot morphology, open-source clips vary in quality, and simulation-collected robot trajectories still require feasibility checking. To address these challenges, we propose a data-centric training and deployment pipeline that integrates motion data curation, real-to-sim model adaptation, AMP-based reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real deployment. We validate the framework on the Booster T1 robot and further provide preliminary cross-platform validation on Booster K1.
tldr: This paper presents a data-centric pipeline for learning deployable humanoid locomotion policies, integrating motion data curation, real-to-sim adaptation, AMP-based reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real transfer, validated on the Booster T1 robot with preliminary cross-platform validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据为中心的流水线，用于学习可部署的人形机器人运动策略，集成了运动数据整理、实到仿模型适应、基于AMP的强化学习和仿真到现实迁移，在Booster T1机器人上验证并进行了初步的跨平台验证。
summary_zh: 人形机器人运动学习不仅需要面向任务的控制策略，还需具备可迁移至实体机器人的物理可行性与自然性行为。然而，机器人可行的运动数据往往稀缺：原始人类示教可能与机器人形态不兼容，开源运动片段质量参差不齐，仿真采集的机器人轨迹仍需可行性校验。针对上述挑战，我们提出一种以数据为核心的训练与部署框架，该框架整合了运动数据筛选、虚实模型适配、基于对抗运动先验的强化学习以及仿真到现实的迁移部署。我们在Booster T1机器人上验证了该框架，并在Booster K1机器人上提供了初步的跨平台验证。

title: DIM-WAM: World-Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory
summary: World-action models have shown promising robot-manipulation performance by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. However, existing methods mainly rely on short-term history and short-horizon future prediction, which is insufficient for long-horizon tasks whose correct execution depends on earlier observations and task progress. Such temporally dependent tasks require effective use of complementary temporal information, including recent local context, cross-stage historical events, immediate future dynamics, and global task progress. To address long-term forgetting and poor awareness of the global task state, we introduce DiM-WAM, a memory-augmented world-action model that integrates multi-scale historical context, local future dynamics, and global task progress. The memory extracts compact visual event information from real observations, updates multiple memory banks through independent similarity-based merging, and then reads the bank-identity- and time-embedded long-term context to condition video and action denoising. A progress-supervision objective further encourages memory tokens to encode not only completed historical events but also the current task stage and its implications for the remaining task. On RMBench, DiM-WAM raises average success from 28.4% with LingBot-VA to 69.8%, exceeding the explicit-memory Mem-0 baseline at 42.0%. On four real-world Franka tasks, it improves average stage success from 70.7% to 91.5% and full-task success from 52.5% to 80.0%. Project page: https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam/{\texttt{https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam/}}.
tldr: DiM-WAM introduces a memory-augmented world-action model with multi-scale memory banks and progress supervision to improve long-horizon robot manipulation, achieving large gains on RMBench and real-world Franka tasks.
tldr_zh: DiM-WAM 提出了一种带有记忆增强的世界-动作模型，通过多尺度记忆库和进度监督来改善长期机器人操作，在 RMBench 和真实 Franka 任务上取得了大幅性能提升。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型通过联合预测未来视觉状态与动作，在机器人操作任务中展现出优异性能。然而，现有方法主要依赖短期历史数据与短时域未来预测，难以满足需依据早期观测与任务进度正确执行的长期任务需求。这类时间依赖性任务要求有效利用互补性时间信息，包括近期局部上下文、跨阶段历史事件、即时未来动态及全局任务进度。为解决长期遗忘与全局任务状态感知不足的问题，我们提出DiM-WAM——一种融合多尺度历史上下文、局部未来动态与全局任务进度的记忆增强型世界-动作模型。该记忆模块从真实观测中提取紧凑视觉事件信息，通过基于独立相似度的合并机制更新多个记忆库，并读取嵌入库标识与时间信息的长期上下文以调控视频与动作去噪过程。进度监督目标进一步促使记忆标记不仅编码已发生的历史事件，还编码当前任务阶段及其对后续任务的影响。在RMBench基准上，DiM-WAM将平均成功率从LingBot-VA的28.4%提升至69.8%，超越显式记忆基线方法Mem-0的42.0%。四项真实世界Franka任务中，平均阶段成功率从70.7%提升至91.5%，完整任务成功率从52.5%提升至80.0%。项目主页：https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam/。

title: CWI: Composite Humanoid Whole-Body Imitation System for Loco-manipulation
summary: Achieving everyday tasks with humanoid robots requires coordinating stable locomotion with versatile manipulation. However, existing whole-body controllers still face significant challenges. Methods trained solely via command sampling, without motion-capture (MoCap) data, often struggle with sparse rewards and require carefully tuned curricula to converge. This is especially problematic for upper-body control, where the resulting motions deviate from human-like statistics and degrade whole-body coordination. Conversely, approaches that imitate full-body MoCap data suffer from dataset imbalance, as many locomotion trajectories are overly aggressive for stable-locomotion scenarios, necessitating extensive data filtering and augmentation. To address this, we present Composite Whole-Body Imitation (CWI), a framework that decouples the use of MoCap data for upper-body manipulation and lower-body locomotion. This decoupling allows us to exploit the full MoCap dataset of diverse manipulation references, while stable, command-conditioned lower-body locomotion is guided by dual discriminators trained on curated expert-quality walking and squatting clips via an Adversarial Motion Prior (AMP). A multi-critic architecture reduces conflicts among locomotion, manipulation, and motion-style objectives, and a teacher--student distillation stage yields a whole-body policy conditioned only on bimanual hand poses and velocity/height commands. We evaluate CWI through simulation experiments and real-world deployment on a full-size LimX Oli humanoid. The results show competitive loco-manipulation performance, robust whole-body coordination, and practical teleoperation without full-body motion-capture equipment. A project page with supplementary material can be found at https://cwi-ral.github.io/CWI-RAL-Webpage.
tldr: A composite imitation framework that decouples upper-body manipulation (MoCap-based) and lower-body locomotion (AMP with curated gait data) for humanoid loco-manipulation, using multi-critic reinforcement learning and teacher-student distillation for real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 一种复合模仿学习框架，将上半身操作（基于MoCap）与下半身运动（AMP与精选步态数据）解耦，通过多评判器强化学习和师生蒸馏实现类人机器人全身协调与真实部署。
summary_zh: 使用人形机器人完成日常任务，需要将稳定运动与灵巧操作协调统一。然而，现有的全身控制器仍面临重大挑战。仅通过指令采样训练、未使用运动捕捉数据的方法，往往难以处理稀疏奖励问题，且需要精心设计的课程表才能收敛。这对上肢控制尤为棘手，产生的动作会偏离人类运动特征，并削弱全身协调性。反之，模仿全身运动捕捉数据的方法则存在数据集失衡问题——大量运动轨迹对稳定运动场景而言过于剧烈，导致需要繁琐的数据筛选与增强。为此，我们提出复合全身模仿（CWI）框架，该框架将运动捕捉数据解耦为上肢操作与下肢运动。这种解耦使我们能利用包含多样化操作参考的完整运动捕捉数据集，而基于指令的稳定下肢运动则通过对抗性运动先验（AMP）训练的双判别器引导，这些判别器基于精选的高质量行走与蹲伏片段训练。多评价器架构可减少运动、操作及动作风格目标之间的冲突，而教师-学生蒸馏阶段则生成仅依赖双手姿态与速度/高度指令的全身策略。我们通过仿真实验及在全尺寸LimX Oli人形机器人上的实际部署评估了CWI。结果表明，该方法具有竞争性的运动-操作性能、稳健的全身协调性，且无需全身运动捕捉设备即可实现实用遥操作。项目页面及补充材料详见https://cwi-ral.github.io/CWI-RAL-Webpage。

title: Characterizing Driver Interactions with Autonomous Vehicles via Response Maps
summary: Understanding human responses to autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors is essential for socially aware interaction, which is crucial for socially compatible navigation in shared traffic environments. We characterize human driving responses in interactions with AVs as feedback laws over the coupled state space of the human driven vehicle and the AV. We model the human driver's actions using a response map, a concept based in game theory, and employ a linear representation to capture driver behaviors as a function of AV behaviors, based on empirical data from a driving simulator study. Our results show that 1) human driver acceleration behavior can be captured using response maps, and 2) human driver responses differ significantly with respect to AV behaviors of yielding, non-yielding, and responsive to the human driver.
tldr: This paper models human driver responses to autonomous vehicle behaviors using game-theoretic response maps, validated with simulator data to show differences in driver reactions to yielding, non-yielding, and responsive AV behaviors.
tldr_zh: 本文利用博弈论中的响应图来建模人类驾驶员对自动驾驶汽车行为的反应，并通过模拟器数据验证，展示了驾驶员对让行、不让行和响应性自动驾驶汽车行为的不同反应。
summary_zh: 理解人类对自动驾驶车辆（AV）行为的反应对于实现具有社会意识的交互至关重要，而这对于共享交通环境中具备社会兼容性的导航至关重要。我们将人类在与AV交互过程中的驾驶反应表征为人类驾驶车辆与AV耦合状态空间上的反馈规律。基于博弈论中的概念，我们采用反应图谱来建模人类驾驶员的行为，并利用线性表示方法，根据驾驶模拟器研究的经验数据，捕捉驾驶员行为作为AV行为的函数。研究结果表明：1）人类驾驶员的加速行为可通过反应图谱进行捕捉；2）人类驾驶员的反应在AV采取让行、不让行以及响应人类驾驶员的不同行为之间存在显著差异。

title: SceneBot: Contact-Prompted General Humanoid Whole Body Tracking with Scene-Interaction
summary: Current humanoid reinforcement-learning policies excel at free-space motions but struggle with contact-rich tasks, as pure kinematic tracking cannot resolve the physical ambiguities of interacting with objects and uneven terrain. To address this, we introduce SceneBot, a unified motion-tracking framework capable of handling freespace locomotion, terrain traversal, and whole-body manipulation. SceneBot conditions a single policy on both reference motions and per-link contact labels, explicitly defining expected environmental interactions. To overcome the lack of annotated interaction data, we propose a hindsight scene reconstruction approach that infers scene-interaction graphs from retargeted human motion. Trained on 7.5 hours of this reconstructed, contact-rich data, SceneBot successfully generalizes to unseen motions and environments. Our results demonstrate that SceneBot is the first general framework to seamlessly unify free-space and contact-rich behaviors executing complex, long-horizon tasks like carrying a box upstairs and establishing contact conditioning as a powerful interface for humanoid control. All code and data will be open-sourced. More demos and information are available at: https://ericcsr.github.io/scenebot/
tldr: SceneBot introduces a unified whole-body tracking framework for humanoid robots that conditions a single policy on reference motions and per-link contact labels, enabling both free-space and contact-rich behaviors like carrying a box upstairs.
tldr_zh: SceneBot 提出了一种统一的人形机器人全身跟踪框架，通过将策略基于参考运动和每个连杆的接触标签，使其能够同时处理自由空间和接触丰富的行为，例如搬箱子上楼。
summary_zh: 摘要：现有的人形机器人强化学习策略在自由空间运动中表现优异，但在涉及接触的任务中面临挑战，因为纯运动学跟踪无法解决与物体交互及不平坦地形中的物理模糊性。为此，我们提出SceneBot——一个统一的运动跟踪框架，能够处理自由空间运动、地形穿越及全身操控。SceneBot将单一策略同时基于参考运动与每连杆接触标签进行条件约束，明确定义了预期的环境交互。为解决缺乏标注交互数据的问题，我们提出了一种事后场景重建方法，通过重定向的人体运动推断场景交互图。基于7.5小时这种重建的接触丰富数据训练后，SceneBot成功泛化至未见过的运动与环境。实验结果表明，SceneBot是首个无缝统一自由空间与接触行为的通用框架，可执行搬箱上楼等复杂长时序任务，并将接触条件建立为人形机器人控制的强效接口。所有代码与数据将开源，更多演示与信息请访问：https://ericcsr.github.io/scenebot/

title: Radar Guided Camera Verification for Automatic Emergency Braking Rethinking Object Detection in Radar Camera Fusion
summary: Radar camera fusion is widely used in Automatic Emergency Braking AEB systems because radar provides reliable range and velocity measurements while cameras provide a proper visual confirmation of the objects . Most of the deployed systems perform this confirmation using computationally intensive object detectors. However, if the radar has already localized a target, the camera may only need to verify the obstacles presence rather than solving a full problem by identifying the object. Our work proposes a radar scoped edge density gate that performs obstacle verification within radar guided image regions of interest. This method requires no training data, model weights, or GPU acceleration and was integrated into a complete radar camera fusion AEB system with brake by wire actuation. Evaluated on a real instrumented vehicle across 72 driving sessions and 131,603 camera frames, the proposed approach reduced the camera search space by up to 98.7 percentage, achieved a mean processing latency of 0.121 ms per ROI, an AUC of 0.898, and a recall of 0.994. Across 33 staged threat scenarios, the complete AEB system recorded zero missed brake events.
tldr: Proposes a radar-guided edge density gate for obstacle verification in AEB, requiring no training data or GPU, and demonstrates real-vehicle validation with high recall and latency reduction.
tldr_zh: 提出一种雷达引导的边缘密度门控方法用于自动紧急制动的障碍物验证，无需训练数据或GPU，并在实车测试中实现了高召回率和低延迟。
summary_zh: 雷达相机融合广泛应用于自动紧急制动（AEB）系统，这是因为雷达能够提供可靠的距离与速度测量，而相机则可对目标进行有效的视觉确认。目前大多数部署的系统采用计算密集型目标检测器来完成这一确认过程。然而，若雷达已完成目标定位，相机仅需验证障碍物是否存在，而无需通过识别目标来解决完整问题。本研究提出了一种雷达限定边缘密度门控方法，可在雷达引导的图像感兴趣区域内执行障碍物验证。该方法无需训练数据、模型权重或GPU加速，并已集成至包含线控制动执行机构的完整雷达相机融合AEB系统中。在真实测试车辆上进行的72次驾驶测试与131,603帧相机图像评估表明，所提方法将相机搜索空间缩减最高达98.7%，每个ROI的平均处理延迟为0.121毫秒，AUC达0.898，召回率达0.994。在33次预设威胁场景的测试中，完整AEB系统实现了零漏制动事件。

title: HAT-4D: Lifting Monocular Video for 4D Multi-Object Interactions via Human-Agent Collaboration
summary: Extracting dynamic 4D object interactions from massive, in-the-wild monocular videos offers a highly efficient data collection pathway for scaling Embodied AI and training VLAs. However, existing monocular 4D reconstruction methods primarily focus on isolated objects, often failing under the severe occlusions and complex dynamics inherent in multi-object interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose HAT-4D, the first agentic framework designed to reconstruct the 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from a single video. By integrating VLMs with a multi-level human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism, HAT-4D efficiently resolves depth ambiguities and interaction-induced occlusions during 3D generation and 4D propagation, yielding physically plausible assets without relying on expensive multicamera rigs. As a scalable data engine, HAT-4D facilitates the creation of MVOIK-4D, an open-world benchmark for monocular 4D interaction reconstruction, accompanied by a novel multi-dimensional evaluation protocol focused on physical plausibility and temporal consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HAT-4D achieves SOTA performance on most evaluation metrics, while maintaining competitive semantic alignment. Ablation studies show that introducing a small amount of human feedback improves interaction reconstruction. Moreover, the data produced by HAT-4D effectively improves baseline performance when used for fine-tuning. Our data and code are available at https://lijiaxin0111.github.io/HAT4D/
tldr: An agentic framework that uses VLMs and human feedback to reconstruct 4D multi-object interactions from monocular video, serving as a data engine for embodied AI and VLA training.
tldr_zh: 一个利用VLM和人类反馈从单目视频重建多物体4D交互的智能框架，为具身AI和VLA训练提供数据引擎。
summary_zh: 从大规模野外单目视频中提取动态4D物体交互，为规模化具身智能与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的训练提供了一条高效的数据采集路径。然而，现有单目4D重建方法主要聚焦于孤立物体，在多物体交互场景下常因严重遮挡与复杂动态而失效。为弥补这一差距，我们提出HAT-4D——首个旨在从单段视频中重建多物体3D几何、时间动态及物理交互的智能体框架。通过将视觉语言模型（VLM）与多级人在回路反馈机制相结合，HAT-4D在3D生成与4D传播过程中高效解决深度歧义与交互引发的遮挡问题，在无需依赖昂贵多相机阵列的前提下产出物理合理的资产。作为可扩展的数据引擎，HAT-4D助力构建了MVOIK-4D——面向单目4D交互重建的开放世界基准，并配套设计了专注于物理合理性与时间一致性的新型多维评估协议。大量实验表明，HAT-4D在大部分评估指标上达到最优性能，同时保持具有竞争力的语义对齐能力。消融研究显示，引入少量人工反馈即可改进交互重建效果。此外，HAT-4D生成的数据在用于微调时有效提升了基线性能。我们的数据与代码已开源在 https://lijiaxin0111.github.io/HAT4D/

title: AirGroundBench: Probing Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal Large Models under Heterogeneous Multi-View Embodied Collaboration
summary: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied intelligence, yet their ability to maintain geometrically consistent spatial understanding across heterogeneous views remains under-evaluated. Existing benchmarks largely focus on single-agent, single-view perception, leaving a gap in the systematic assessment of collaborative air-ground settings, where multi-scale observations are complementary but introduce scale mismatch, asymmetric occlusion, and reference-frame inconsistencies. We present AirGroundBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating multi-view spatial intelligence in heterogeneous UAV-UGV collaboration. AirGroundBench is built from 11 high-fidelity simulated environments with 1,021 synchronized air-ground observation pairs, yielding approximately 62,000 dual-view, four-option single-choice visual question answering instances and 115 closed-loop vision-language navigation episodes. It covers 10 task types organized into four progressively demanding capability dimensions: spatial perception, cross-view alignment, spatial transformation and reasoning, and embodied decision-making. To support geometry-grounded evaluation and analysis, we provide structured spatial annotations, including cross-view object identities and metric 2D and 3D bounding boxes. Evaluations of 13 representative MLLMs under UAV-only, UGV-only, and dual-view input settings reveal consistent bottlenecks: models perform relatively well on spatial perception but struggle with cross-view alignment and transformation-intensive reasoning, and these deficits propagate to sequential decision-making in vision-language navigation. Although dual-view inputs provide measurable gains over single-view variants, a persistent gap from human performance remains, highlighting geometric consistency as a key limitation of current embodied MLLMs.
tldr: AirGroundBench is a benchmark for evaluating spatial intelligence in multimodal LLMs under heterogeneous UAV-UGV collaborative embodied settings, revealing that models struggle with cross-view alignment and transformation, limiting embodied decision-making.
tldr_zh: AirGroundBench 是一个在异构无人机-无人车协同具身场景下评估多模态大模型空间智能的基准，揭示了模型在跨视角对齐和变换推理上的不足，影响了具身决策。
summary_zh: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在具身智能领域展现出巨大潜力，但其在不同视角间保持几何一致的空间理解能力仍缺乏充分评估。现有基准测试主要聚焦于单智能体、单视角感知，尚未系统评估空地协同场景——该场景中多尺度观测虽具有互补性，却存在尺度错配、非对称遮挡及参考系不一致等问题。我们提出AirGroundBench，这是一个用于评估异构无人机-无人车协同中多视角空间智能的诊断性基准。该基准基于11个高保真仿真环境构建，包含1021组同步空地观测对，总计约6.2万个双视角四选一视觉问答实例及115个闭环视觉语言导航任务。它涵盖10类任务类型，按能力要求递增分为四个维度：空间感知、跨视角对齐、空间变换与推理、具身决策。为支持基于几何的评估分析，我们提供结构化空间标注，包括跨视角物体身份标识及二维/三维度量边界框。在仅无人机、仅无人车及双视角输入三种设置下对13个代表性MLLMs的评估揭示了持续存在的瓶颈：模型在空间感知上表现相对良好，但在跨视角对齐与强变换推理任务中困难重重，且这些缺陷会传导至视觉语言导航的序列决策过程。尽管双视角输入相较于单视角模式带来可量化的性能提升，但与人类表现仍存在显著差距，这凸显了几何一致性作为当前具身MLLMs关键局限性的本质。

title: MVPruner: Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Multi-view Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) improve generalization and interpretability in autonomous driving but suffer from efficiency issues due to long visual token sequences, particularly in standard multi-view settings. Existing token pruning methods employ fixed pruning rate allocation and static importance metrics, ignoring dynamic inter-view importance differences and the evolving information importance during inference. Our analysis reveals that multi-view VLMs inherently encode task-related view priors in deeper layers and exhibit dynamic information requirements. Motivated by these findings, we propose MVPruner, a two-stage adaptive token pruning method that aligns pruning behavior with the model's dynamic information requirements. The first stage allocates pruning budgets based on the information diversity of each view, and retains tokens with consistent contribution across stages, ensuring semantic representational capacity. The second stage allocates budgets and selects tokens guided by instruction text to guarantee task alignment. Experimental results on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of our method. For example, DriveMM equipped with MVPruner achieves 87.3% reduction in FLOPs, 4.97* speedup in prefilling phase while retaining 98.5% accuracy on DriveLM benchmark.
tldr: MVPruner proposes a two-stage dynamic token pruning method for multi-view vision-language models in autonomous driving, achieving significant speedup and FLOP reduction while maintaining high accuracy.
tldr_zh: MVPruner提出了一种用于自动驾驶多视角视觉语言模型的两阶段动态令牌剪枝方法，在保持高准确率的同时实现了显著的加速和FLOP降低。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶领域提升了泛化能力和可解释性，但由于视觉标记序列过长（尤其在标准多视角设置下），存在效率问题。现有标记剪枝方法采用固定剪枝率分配和静态重要性度量，忽略了推理过程中视角间动态的重要性差异以及信息重要性的演变。我们的分析表明，多视角VLM在深层网络中天然编码了与任务相关的视角先验，并展现出动态的信息需求。基于这些发现，我们提出MVPruner——一种两阶段自适应标记剪枝方法，使剪枝行为与模型的动态信息需求对齐。第一阶段根据各视角的信息多样性分配剪枝预算，并保留跨阶段贡献一致的标记，确保语义表征能力。第二阶段通过指令文本引导预算分配与标记筛选，保证任务对齐。在四个基准数据集上的实验结果表明了本方法的优越性能。例如，配备MVPruner的DriveMM模型在DriveLM基准上实现了87.3%的FLOPs削减、4.97倍的预填充阶段加速，同时保持了98.5%的准确率。

title: CascadeOcc: Rethinking 3D Occupancy World Models with Cascaded VQ Representations
summary: This letter proposes CascadeOcc, a novel occupancy world model that prioritizes intrinsic structural hierarchy over extrinsic auxiliary modalities for autonomous driving. Occupancy world models -- forecasting the future driving environment and planning the driving trajectory -- effectively bridge perception and planning, but current approaches often heavily rely on external modalities or large language models, failing to fully exploit the inherent structural potential of occupancy representations themselves. To enhance representational capacity for complex 3D scenes, we integrate a cascaded Vector Quantized (VQ) mechanism into an autoregressive framework. Following a coarse-to-fine principle, CascadeOcc progressively refines fine-grained details from global structures through a multi-scale architecture. Additionally, we incorporate a TimeMixer to capture multi-scale temporal dependencies, establishing a dual-hierarchy mechanism in both space and time. Experimental results on 4D occupancy forecasting and motion planning benchmarks demonstrate that CascadeOcc achieves superior performance among vision-centric approaches, validating that optimizing inherent representations is a powerful alternative to relying on external foundation models.
tldr: CascadeOcc proposes a cascaded VQ-based autoregressive occupancy world model for autonomous driving that exploits spatial-temporal hierarchy without relying on external modalities or LLMs.
tldr_zh: CascadeOcc 提出了一种基于级联 VQ 的自回归占用世界模型，利用时空层次结构进行自动驾驶，不依赖外部模态或大语言模型。
summary_zh: 本信提出CascadeOcc——一种新颖的占用世界模型，该模型优先利用内在结构层次性而非外部辅助模态进行自动驾驶。占用世界模型通过预测未来驾驶环境并规划行驶轨迹，有效衔接感知与规划环节，但当前方法往往严重依赖外部模态或大语言模型，未能充分挖掘占用表示本身固有的结构潜力。为增强对复杂三维场景的表征能力，我们将级联矢量量化（VQ）机制集成到自回归框架中。遵循由粗到精的原则，CascadeOcc通过多尺度架构逐步从全局结构中细化细节。此外，我们引入TimeMixer捕获多尺度时间依赖关系，在空间与时间维度建立双层次机制。在4D占用预测与运动规划基准上的实验结果表明，CascadeOcc在视觉中心方法中取得了优异性能，验证了优化内在表示是替代依赖外部基础模型的有效途径。

title: Unleashing Infinite Motion: Scaling Expressive Quadrupedal Motion via Generative Video Priors
summary: Quadruped robots have achieved remarkable locomotion, yet their behavioral repertoire remains confined to a few gaits--far from the expressive, companion-like presence long envisioned for them. Attempts to import the humanoid recipe of large-scale motion data have inherited one tacit assumption: that robot motion must first pass through an animal body, making data collection dependent on cooperative animals, reconstruction fragile across species, and retargeting ill-posed across incompatible morphologies. We propose Uni-Mo, a fully automated pipeline that removes the animal from the loop by reframing data scarcity as a generation problem: an LLM proposes motion prompts, a video diffusion model synthesizes the corresponding robot behaviors, and the generated videos are lifted into 3D reference trajectories used to train tracking policies deployed on a real Unitree Go2. To make naively-drifting generations reliably extractable, we introduce an Identity Consistency Loss that enforces appearance coherence across frames. We release Quad-Imaginarium at https://github.com/GaoLii/Quad-Imaginarium.git, the resulting open-source dataset of 7,488 language-annotated quadruped motions (18.5 hours) spanning acrobatic and performative behaviors. We validate 392 randomly sampled motions on a real Unitree Go2 with a 96.7% deployment success rate, complemented by a 97.6% success rate across the full dataset in simulation.
tldr: Uni-Mo uses an LLM and video diffusion model to generate synthetic quadruped robot motion data, then lifts these videos into 3D trajectories to train a tracking policy, achieving high deployment success on a real robot.
tldr_zh: Uni-Mo 利用 LLM 和视频扩散模型生成四足机器人运动数据，将生成的视频提升为 3D 轨迹以训练跟踪策略，在真实机器人上实现了高部署成功率。
summary_zh: 四足机器人已实现卓越的运动能力，但其行为库仍局限于少数步态模式——远未达到人们长期设想的富有表现力、如伴侣般的交互形态。将人形机器人大规模运动数据范式移植至四足领域时，学界默认了一个隐含前提：机器人动作必须首先通过动物身体进行采集，这导致数据收集依赖动物协作、跨物种重建脆弱、且不同形态间的重定向存在不适定性。我们提出Uni-Mo全自动流水线，通过将数据匮乏重新定义为生成问题，将动物从流程中移除：大语言模型生成运动提示，视频扩散模型合成对应机器人行为，生成的视频被提升为三维参考轨迹，用于训练部署在真实宇树Go2机器人上的追踪策略。为使原生易漂移的生成结果可稳定提取，我们引入身份一致性损失函数，强制帧间外观连贯性。我们在https://github.com/GaoLii/Quad-Imaginarium.git开源数据集Quad-Imaginarium，包含7,488个带语言标注的四足运动（18.5小时），涵盖杂技与表演行为。在真实宇树Go2机器人上对392个随机采样动作的验证部署成功率为96.7%，全数据集仿真补充验证成功率为97.6%。

title: Learning Stable In-Grasp Manipulation in a Non-Dropping Action Space
summary: Traditionally, dexterous manipulation controllers are designed using analytic models constrained by strong assumptions about the hand and the objects being manipulated. Reinforcement learning (RL) has become another common approach in which skills are explored openly in an end-to-end manner but is inefficient because of unnoticeable instability and conflicts in learning objectives. This paper attempts to efficiently explore stable and accurate manipulation skills by decomposing dexterous skills into multiple simpler/analyzable components. Each skill component is subsequently learned with constraints and guidance from classical physics and control theory. Our work shows that for stable grasp, in-grasp reposition/reorientation with different objects, sensor/motor noise, latency, and frictional conditions, skill learning becomes efficient and stable with prior knowledge from theory.
tldr: This paper proposes decomposing dexterous in-grasp manipulation into simpler components and learning each with constraints from classical physics and control theory, improving RL efficiency and stability for repositioning/reorienting objects under various conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将灵巧手内操作分解为更简单的组件，并利用经典物理和控制理论的约束分别学习每个组件，从而在多种物体、传感器噪声和摩擦条件下提高强化学习的效率和稳定性。
summary_zh: 传统上，灵巧操作控制器是基于强假设条件（关于手部及被操作物体）的分析模型设计的。强化学习已成为另一种常见方法，该方法以端到端的方式开放探索技能，但因学习目标中不易察觉的不稳定性与冲突而效率低下。本文尝试通过将灵巧技能分解为多个更简单/可分析的组件，来高效探索稳定且精准的操作技能。每个技能组件随后在经典物理学与控制理论的约束与引导下进行学习。研究表明，在稳定抓取、对不同物体进行抓取内重定位/重新定向、传感器/电机噪声、延迟及摩擦条件等场景下，融入理论先验知识能使技能学习兼具高效性与稳定性。

title: LLawCo: Learning Laws of Cooperation for Modeling Embodied Multi-Agent Behavior
summary: Embodied agents operating in decentralized and partially observable environments have attracted growing attention in recent years. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based agents often exhibit behaviors that are misaligned with their partners or inconsistent with the environment state, leading to inefficient cooperation and poor task success. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework, Learning Laws of Cooperation (LLawCo), that enables embodied agents to autonomously align with both their partners and task objectives. Our framework allows agents to reflect on past failures to extract misaligned behavioral patterns, which are used to derive high-level behavioral laws, such as "Talk when necessary" and "Wait for partner." These laws are explicitly incorporated into the agents' chains of thought via supervised fine-tuning, aligning their reasoning with task requirements and the behavior of other agents. To evaluate our approach, we introduce PARTNR-Dialog, a large-scale multi-agent communicative and cooperative planning benchmark built on the PARTNR environment. Experiments on existing tasks and our new benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in cooperative efficiency and task success rates. Across four backbone LLMs, our method achieves average success rate improvements of 4.5% on the PARTNR-Dialog benchmark and 6.8% on the TDW-MAT benchmark over state-of-the-art open-source communicative agent frameworks. See the LLawCo project page for details: https://www.merl.com/research/highlights/LLawCo
tldr: LLawCo introduces a framework where LLM-based embodied agents extract behavioral laws from past failures via reflection and incorporate them into chain-of-thought reasoning via supervised fine-tuning, achieving improved cooperation and task success in multi-agent partially observable environments.
tldr_zh: LLawCo 提出一个框架，让基于大语言模型的具身智能体通过反思过去失败提取行为法则，并通过监督微调将这些法则融入思维链推理，从而在多智能体部分可观测环境中提升协作效率和任务成功率。
summary_zh: 在分散且部分可观测环境中运行的具身智能体近年来吸引了越来越多的关注。然而，现有基于大语言模型的智能体常常表现出与合作伙伴不一致或与环境状态不符的行为，导致协作效率低下和任务成功率欠佳。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖框架——合作法则学习（LLawCo），使具身智能体能够自主地与合作伙伴及任务目标保持一致。该框架允许智能体反思过往失败，提取出失调的行为模式，并据此推导出高层次的行为法则，例如“必要时沟通”和“等待伙伴”。这些法则通过监督微调被明确纳入智能体的思维链中，使其推理过程与任务要求及其他智能体的行为对齐。为评估我们的方法，我们引入了PARTNR-Dialog——一个基于PARTNR环境构建的大规模多智能体通信与协作规划基准。在现有任务及我们新基准上的实验表明，该方法在协作效率与任务成功率方面均有显著提升。在四个骨干大语言模型上，我们的方法相较于最先进的开源通信智能体框架，在PARTNR-Dialog基准上平均成功率提升4.5%，在TDW-MAT基准上提升6.8%。详情请参见LLawCo项目页面：https://www.merl.com/research/highlights/LLawCo

title: Drifting in the Future: Stabilizing Path Following Drifting on High-Latency Vehicle Systems
summary: Autonomously controlling and handling a vehicle at and beyond its stability limit is a mathematically and computationally demanding task. Prior demonstrations of automated drifting have been limited to research platforms with instantaneous torque delivery and independently actuated wheels, leaving their applicability to production vehicles with actuator latencies and mechanically coupled axles uncertain. To overcome these issues, we design a predictor to compensate for powertrain delays, develop a revised control formulation to accommodate higher actuation latencies as well as a differential coupling on the driven axle, and introduce brake-based velocity stabilization. This paper presents the controller framework, the model extensions, and real-world experimental results. We observe that our controller enables a production sports car with a combustion engine to robustly sustain circular and figure-eight drifts, limiting lateral error to 1.1 m and sideslip overshoot to 0.06 rad despite actuator delays exceeding 250 ms, while mitigating oscillations and maintaining stable path and sideslip tracking. In conclusion, our results establish that autonomous drifting is feasible on production-ready vehicles, opening pathways to advanced safety systems capable of stabilizing cars in scenarios where traditional control fails.
tldr: This paper presents a controller framework that enables a production sports car with a combustion engine to perform autonomous drifting despite actuator delays over 250 ms, using powertrain delay compensation and brake-based velocity stabilization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种控制器框架，使配备内燃机的量产跑车能够在超过250毫秒的执行器延迟下实现自主漂移，通过动力总成延迟补偿和基于刹车的速度稳定来实现。
summary_zh: 自主控制并操纵车辆处于或超越其稳定性极限，是一项在数学和计算上要求极高的任务。此前的自动漂移演示仅局限于具备瞬时扭矩输出和独立驱动轮的研究平台，其能否应用于存在执行器延迟且车桥为机械耦合结构的量产车辆尚不明确。为克服这些问题，我们设计了一个预测器以补偿动力系统延迟，开发了改进的控制算法以适配更高的执行器延迟及驱动轴的差速耦合特性，并引入了基于制动系统的速度稳定控制。本文展示了控制器框架、模型扩展方案以及实际道路实验的结果。我们观察到，尽管执行器延迟超过250毫秒，所提出的控制器仍能使一辆配备内燃机的量产跑车稳健地维持定圆与八字漂移，横向误差控制在1.1米以内，侧偏角超调量控制在0.06弧度以内，同时有效抑制振荡并保持稳定的路径与侧偏角跟踪。综上所述，研究结果证实了自动漂移技术在量产车型上的可行性，为开发能在传统控制失效场景下稳定车辆的先进安全系统开辟了道路。

title: SpikeVLA: Vision-Language-Action Models with Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing approaches are built on large-scale transformers, resulting in substantial inference latency and energy consumption that limit their practical deployment in low-power, real-time scenarios. We propose SpikeVLA, a spiking VLA architecture for embodied navigation with energy-efficient inference, consisting of three key components. (i) A spiking vision encoder, Spike-V, that replaces dense continuous layers with event-driven spiking layers to reduce the energy consumption of visual representation learning. (ii) A multi-modal spiking large language model, Spike-L, that reformulates cross-modal reasoning with spiking dynamics and token-level event-driven sparsity to further lower computational cost. (iii) A spiking action policy network, Spike-A employs Laplacian-kernel population coding with a multi-layer fully connected SNN, and decodes spiking activities into stable and robust continuous control with energy-efficient inference under low-power constraints. Experiments on navigation and robotic control tasks show that SpikeVLA significantly reduces energy consumption and computational cost while maintaining competitive performance, highlighting its potential for low-power, real-time embodied intelligence.
tldr: SpikeVLA replaces dense transformer layers in VLA models with spiking neural networks to reduce energy consumption and latency for embodied navigation and control, maintaining competitive performance.
tldr_zh: SpikeVLA使用脉冲神经网络替代VLA模型中的密集Transformer层，降低能耗和延迟，用于具身导航和控制，同时保持竞争性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为具身智能的主导范式。然而，现有方法大多基于大规模Transformer架构，导致推理延迟和能耗过高，限制了其在低功耗、实时场景中的实际部署。我们提出SpikeVLA——一种面向具身导航的脉冲VLA架构，具有低能耗推理能力，由三个关键组件构成：（i）脉冲视觉编码器Spike-V，用事件驱动的脉冲层替代密集连续层，降低视觉表征学习的能耗；（ii）多模态脉冲大语言模型Spike-L，通过脉冲动力学与令牌级事件驱动稀疏性重构跨模态推理，进一步降低计算成本；（iii）脉冲动作策略网络Spike-A，采用拉普拉斯核种群编码与多层全连接脉冲神经网络，在低功耗约束下将脉冲活动解码为稳定鲁棒的连续控制信号，实现低能耗推理。在导航与机器人控制任务上的实验表明，SpikeVLA在保持竞争性能的同时显著降低了能耗与计算成本，凸显了其在低功耗、实时具身智能领域的应用潜力。

title: RS-Diffuser: Risk-Sensitive Diffusion Planning with Distributional Value Guidance
summary: Offline reinforcement learning enables policy learning from fixed datasets without additional environment interaction, making it appealing for safety-critical applications where online exploration is costly or unsafe. Diffusion-based decision-making methods have recently achieved strong performance in offline RL by modeling rich, multimodal trajectory distributions. However, existing diffusion planners are typically risk-neutral and therefore may overlook rare but catastrophic outcomes that are crucial in real-world deployment. In this work, we propose RS-Diffuser, a risk-sensitive offline diffusion planning framework that combines diffusion-based trajectory generation with distributional value critics. RS-Diffuser learns a diffusion planner over future state trajectories, a separate inverse dynamics model for action decoding, and a Monte Carlo distributional critic that estimates the full return distribution of candidate plans through quantile regression. At sampling time, we incorporate a risk-sensitive guidance signal into the denoising process, using gradients computed from tail-aware objectives such as Conditional Value at Risk to steer generation toward desired risk profiles. As a result, a single trained model can flexibly produce risk-averse, risk-neutral, or risk-seeking behaviors by changing only the inference-time risk parameter. Extensive experiments on risk-sensitive D4RL and risky robot navigation benchmarks demonstrate that RS-Diffuser achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving both overall return and worst-case robustness while reducing safety violations.
tldr: RS-Diffuser integrates risk-sensitive distributional value guidance into diffusion-based trajectory planning for offline RL, enabling flexible risk profiles at inference time and improving safety in simulated robot navigation.
tldr_zh: RS-Diffuser将风险敏感分布价值指导融入基于扩散的轨迹规划中，使离线强化学习能够在推理时灵活调整风险偏好，在模拟机器人导航中提升安全性与鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 离线强化学习能够在不与外部环境交互的前提下，从固定数据集中学习策略，因此对于在线探索成本高昂或存在安全隐患的安全关键型应用具有吸引力。基于扩散的决策方法通过建模丰富且多模态的轨迹分布，在离线强化学习领域取得了显著成效。然而，现有扩散规划器通常呈风险中性，可能忽视真实部署中至关重要的罕见但灾难性结果。本文提出RS-Diffuser——一种风险敏感的离线扩散规划框架，该框架将基于扩散的轨迹生成与分布式值评论家相结合。RS-Diffuser针对未来状态轨迹学习扩散规划器，构建用于动作解码的独立逆动力学模型，并利用蒙特卡洛分布式评论家通过分位数回归估计候选方案的完整回报分布。在采样阶段，我们将风险敏感引导信号融入去噪过程，利用基于条件风险价值等尾部感知目标计算的梯度，引导生成过程向所需风险配置收敛。由此，单个训练模型仅需改变推理时的风险参数，即可灵活生成风险规避、风险中性或风险寻求行为。在风险敏感D4RL数据集与危险机器人导航基准测试上的大量实验表明，RS-Diffuser实现了最先进的性能，在提升总体回报与最差情况鲁棒性的同时，减少了安全违规事件。

title: Learning to Throw: Agile and Accurate Cable-Suspended Payload Delivery with a Quadrotor
summary: Quadrotors offer the agility needed to rapidly transport suspended payloads during time-critical applications, including search-and-rescue and medical delivery. While suspended-payload transport and traversal for these missions are well studied, the highly dynamic targeted release of the payload remains comparatively underexplored. State-of-the-art approaches typically rely on model-based trajectory optimization and tracking; however, these methods often yield sub-optimal performance due to conservative feasibility constraints, tracking errors, and the inherent difficulty of analytically modeling flexible rope dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hybrid simulation framework that couples a high-fidelity analytical quadrotor model with a physics solver for complex rope and payload interactions. By exchanging forces between the two domains at every step, we obtain a physically accurate simulation of the suspended-payload system. Leveraging this environment, we train a deep reinforcement learning (RL) policy that executes agile, accurate payload throws to designated targets. Deployed zero-shot on hardware, our RL policy pushes the boundary of the agility-accuracy trade-off, outperforming the model-based baseline by reducing the landing error by up to 50% and the throw duration by up to 30%. Ablation studies confirm that the coupled simulation is the key enabler of these gains. We further show that the same pipeline trains a policy driven by visual observations rather than an explicit state estimate, achieving accuracy comparable to that of the state-based policy. To accelerate future research in dynamic aerial manipulation, we open-source the simulator to the community upon acceptance.
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid simulation framework combining a high-fidelity quadrotor model with a physics solver for rope dynamics, enabling a deep RL policy that achieves agile and accurate cable-suspended payload throws, outperforming model-based baselines in both accuracy and speed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合仿真框架，将高保真四旋翼模型与物理求解器耦合以模拟绳索动力学，训练出的深度强化学习策略能够实现快速且精准的缆绳悬挂载荷投掷，在精度和速度上均优于基于模型的基线方法。
summary_zh: 四旋翼飞行器具备执行时间关键型任务（包括搜索救援与医疗物资运送）所需的敏捷性，可快速运输悬挂载荷。尽管针对此类任务的悬挂载荷运输与穿越已有充分研究，但载荷的高动态定向释放仍相对探索不足。现有先进方法通常依赖基于模型的轨迹优化与跟踪，然而由于保守的可行性约束、跟踪误差以及柔性绳索动力学解析建模的固有困难，这些方法往往性能次优。为克服上述局限，我们提出一种混合仿真框架，将高保真解析四旋翼模型与复杂绳索-载荷相互作用的物理求解器相耦合。通过在每一步骤中交换两个域之间的作用力，我们获得了悬挂载荷系统的物理精确仿真。利用该环境，我们训练深度强化学习策略，使其能够向指定目标执行敏捷且精确的载荷投掷。该强化学习策略零样本部署于硬件时，突破了敏捷性与精准性之间的权衡边界，相比基于模型的基线方法，着陆误差降低高达50%，投掷耗时减少30%。消融实验证实，耦合仿真正是实现这些性能提升的关键要素。我们进一步表明，同一流程可训练出由视觉观测而非显式状态估计驱动的策略，其精度与基于状态的策略相当。为加速动态空中操纵技术的未来研究，我们在论文接收后将向社区开源该仿真器。

title: Understanding Rollout Error in Graph World Models
summary: World models are often used for planning by rolling learned dynamics forward. Many planning environments, however, are not vectors or images; they are graphs of agents, tools, skills, routes, and dependencies. In these settings, a local prediction error may stay local or spread through the graph, and the failure mode changes again when edges are predicted rather than fixed. This paper studies long-horizon rollout error in Graph World Models (GWMs). We formulate a unified fixed-edge and dynamic-edge GWM framework with action nodes for node-, edge-, and graph-level decisions. We develop graph-valued rollout bounds that separate topology-induced amplification from model-induced amplification, and we introduce a joint node-edge operator for dynamic-edge rollouts. Guided by the analysis, we propose Error-Aware GWM, which combines spectral regularization, rollout consistency, and critical-node weighting. Across synthetic topologies and heterogeneous agent-graph testbeds, rollout error and planning regret grow with horizon, dynamic-edge training is needed when structure evolves, and Error-Aware GWM prevents long-horizon divergence while preserving prediction accuracy. Real-world graph benchmarks clarify the scope of GWMs: they are most useful for dynamic graph rollout and agent planning, while specialized graph models remain strong on static or sparse prediction tasks.
tldr: This paper studies rollout error in Graph World Models (GWMs) for agent planning on graphs, proposes Error-Aware GWM with spectral regularization and rollout consistency to prevent long-horizon divergence, and validates it on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了图世界模型（GWM）在智能体规划中的展开误差，提出了结合谱正则化与展开一致性的错误感知图世界模型，以防止长时展开的发散，并在合成与真实基准上验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 世界模型常通过前向滚动学习到的动力学来进行规划。然而，许多规划环境并非向量或图像，而是由智能体、工具、技能、路径和依赖关系构成的图。在这些场景中，局部预测误差可能停留在局部，也可能通过图结构扩散；当边是预测所得而非固定不变时，失效模式也会发生变化。本文研究图世界模型中的长时域滚动误差。我们提出了一个统一的固定边与动态边图世界模型框架，其中包含用于节点级、边级和图级决策的动作节点。我们推导了图值滚动误差界，将拓扑结构引发的放大效应与模型自身引发的放大效应分离，并针对动态边滚动引入了联合节点-边算子。在理论分析指导下，我们提出了误差感知图世界模型，该模型融合了谱正则化、滚动一致性和关键节点加权。在合成拓扑与异构智能体-图测试床上的实验表明：滚动误差与规划遗憾随规划时域增长而增大；当结构演化时，动态边训练是必要的；误差感知图世界模型能在保持预测精度的同时防止长时域发散。真实图基准测试明确了图世界模型的适用范围：它们在动态图滚动与智能体规划任务中最具价值，而专用图模型在静态或稀疏预测任务中仍保持优势。

title: Perceptual 3D Simulation With Physical World Modeling
summary: Predicting how a scene will evolve after a desired 3D transformation from images is a central goal in vision, graphics, and robotics. Yet unlike ideal simulators with full access to 3D geometry and dynamics, real world systems must rely on perceptual inputs and local actions that are inherently partial and incomplete. In this work, we present P3Sim, a physical world modeling system that simulates future scene states under both partial observations and incomplete 3D transformation signals. P3Sim is composed of three interacting components: a learned physical world model, a geometric conditioning module, and a persistent scene memory. The world model interprets perception as probabilistic inference over multimodal scene variables, providing predictions of the distributions of any scene variable conditioned on any combination of others. The geometric conditioning module provides a partial 3D transform signal for conditioning the world model at inference time. The persistent scene memory integrates predictions over time, enabling online updates and consistency under uncertainty. By combining learned inference with explicit geometric structure, P3Sim balances data-driven flexibility with built-in inductive bias. This design yields a flexible perceptual simulator that generalizes across diverse 3D transformation tasks, such as novel view synthesis, object manipulation, and dynamic scene prediction, advancing toward general purpose 3D scene understanding and transformation.
tldr: P3Sim is a physical world modeling system that combines a learned world model, geometric conditioning, and persistent scene memory to simulate future scene states from images under partial observations, enabling tasks like novel view synthesis, object manipulation, and dynamic scene prediction.
tldr_zh: P3Sim是一个结合学习的世界模型、几何条件化和持久场景记忆的物理世界建模系统，能从图像在部分观测下模拟未来场景状态，支持新视角合成、物体操作和动态场景预测等任务。
summary_zh: 根据图像预测场景在期望的3D变换后将如何演变，是视觉、图形学和机器人技术的核心目标。然而，与能够完全获取3D几何与动力学的理想模拟器不同，现实世界系统必须依赖本质上具有局部性和不完整性的感知输入与局部动作。在这项工作中，我们提出P3Sim——一个能在部分观测和不完整3D变换信号条件下模拟未来场景状态的物理世界建模系统。P3Sim由三个相互作用组件构成：一个学习的物理世界模型、一个几何条件模块和一个持久场景记忆。世界模型将感知解释为对多模态场景变量的概率推断，提供基于任意变量组合条件下任何场景变量分布的预测。几何条件模块提供部分3D变换信号，用于在推理时约束世界模型。持久场景记忆整合随时间变化的预测，从而实现在线更新和不确定性下的一致性。通过将学习推断与显式几何结构相结合，P3Sim平衡了数据驱动的灵活性与内置归纳偏置。该设计产生了一个灵活的感知模拟器，可泛化至多种3D变换任务，如新视角合成、物体操作和动态场景预测，推动通用3D场景理解与变换的发展。

title: Understanding Cross-Rig Generalization in Automotive Perception: a Multi-Rig Benchmark and Rig Variation Metrics
summary: Camera-based perception systems for autonomous driving are typically developed and evaluated using fixed sensor rigs, while real-world vehicle fleets exhibit substantial variation in camera placement, orientation, field of view, and camera count. This mismatch introduces a cross-rig domain gap in which only the geometric observation process changes. To study this effect under controlled conditions, we introduce Plentiful CARLA Camera Rigs, a benchmark that renders identical driving scenes under 14 systematically designed camera rigs. This setup enables direct analysis of cross-rig generalization without confounding changes in scene content or appearance. Using the benchmark, we analyze cross-rig transfer behavior of representative multi-view perception architectures and observe substantial performance shifts induced by geometric rig variation. To facilitate structured analysis, we further introduce two calibration-based descriptors derived from rig metadata: Rig Variance, capturing internal rig diversity, and Rig Contrastive Distance, measuring geometric discrepancy between rigs. Our experiments show that geometric rig differences strongly correlate with relative cross-rig performance shifts and that Rig Contrastive Distance provides a reliable proxy for ranking transfer difficulty between sensor rigs.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-rig benchmark and metrics to study how camera rig variation affects cross-rig generalization in autonomous driving perception.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个多传感器配置基准和指标，用于研究相机配置变化对自动驾驶感知中跨配置泛化能力的影响。
